sentence: This project tests whether gene therapy that delivers full-length dystrophin can prevent the progression of diseased cardiomyocytes, using hydrogels and stem cells from patients.
This project uses digital phenotyping and epigenetics to understand clinical outcomes in acute hypoxemic respiratory failure without acute respiratory distress syndrome.
This project studies what decides whether immunotherapy works in liver cancer linked to non-alcoholic steatohepatitis.
This project provides facilities used to study how visual system disorders such as glaucoma occur and which neuronal and synaptic mechanisms cause them.
This project studies bats and builds tools to find spillovers, where a pathogen passes from wildlife or livestock to humans.
This project tries to find out which genes are involved in cardiovascular disease and how they work.
This project uses a rat genetic cross to find genes and variants behind risk traits and cocaine use traits.
This project studies antiviral defense in the nematode Caenorhabditis elegans and uses it to discover genes.
This project tries to find out how the bacterium Sodalis glossinidius interacts with insect cells and stays in the tsetse fly as a persistent infection.
This project uses machine learning to identify neurobehavioral phenotypes and brain biotypes in people with HIV.
This project supports a hands-on summer course on how ion channels, synapses and circuits relate to human brain physiology and disease.
This project studies the post-translational protein machinery of Streptococcus mutans, a bacterium linked to severe caries.
This project provides cancer prevention, cancer care delivery and cancer treatment trials to rural communities.
This project develops statistical and machine learning tools to interpret CRISPR screens that study genes linked to psychiatric disorders.
This project combines mouse models with human cell lines to study how mitochondrial dysfunction contributes to Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease.
This project uses positron emission tomography imaging and immunologic biomarkers to monitor how patients with metastatic non-small cell lung cancer respond to treatment.
This project tests whether alpha-1 antitrypsin and monocytes affect inflammation and disease activity in vasculitis.
This project builds a Gingiva-on-a-Chip to study whether nitrate and other compounds could become targeted anti-inflammatory therapeutics for periodontitis.
This project develops computational tools that detect base modifications in DNA and RNA from signals made by a Nanopore sequencer.
This project develops protocols and code for single-cell and spatial transcriptomics methods to study chronic kidney disease.
